conditions.displayName: pdf_failed / delivery_failed / submission_waiting / run_failed / failed_marker_not_written, or the container out of memory

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="${SERVICE}" AND (jsonPayload.event=("pdf_failed" OR "delivery_failed" OR "submission_waiting" OR "run_failed" OR "failed_marker_not_written") OR textPayload:"Memory limit")
